minemories.ui.actif_aussi_en_pause_et_en: Active while paused and in the background too.
minemories.ui.reglages_enregistres_plus_: Settings saved. Smaller means a lighter capture.
minemories.ui.remplis_les_trois_champs_a: Fill all three fields with whole numbers.
minemories.ui.envoie_uniquement_le_souve: Only sends the selected memory. Does not create a new export.
minemories.ui.dossier_local_indisponible: Local folder unavailable. Check the advanced settings.
minemories.ui.souvenir_envoye_dans_ta_ga: Memory sent to your private gallery.
minemories.ui.envoi_uniquement_avec_le_b: Only sends when you use the button below.
minemories.ui.connecte_ta_galerie_via_m_: Connect your gallery using M to send a capture.
minemories.ui.configuration_illisible_au: Unreadable settings: no data is collected.
minemories.ui.retrait_actif_ici_mais_non: Consent withdrawn here, but not saved. Fix file permissions before restarting.
minemories.ui.diagnostics_intro: On by default once you are connected. Helps fix export and crash problems. You can turn it off here at any time.
minemories.ui.versions_erreur_et_lignes_: Versions, error and code lines. Up to eight private reports kept for at most 7 days, retried after restarting.
minemories.ui.exclus_messages_urls_jeton: Excluded: messages, URLs, tokens, coordinates, seed, world/player names and captures.
minemories.ui.non_efface_la_file_locale_: OFF clears the local queue and requests server deletion. While offline, server retention applies.
minemories.ui.voir_lespace_et_comment_li: View storage and ways to free up your gallery.
minemories.ui.capture_les_blocs_charges_: Captures loaded blocks around you and sends the memory to your private gallery.
minemories.ui.chemin_absolu_ou_export_le: Absolute path or ~/export. Dated captures stay in history; capture.glb contains the latest export.
minemories.ui.retablit_ladresse_officiel: Restores the official address. Then click Save.
minemories.ui.definis_les_deux_coins_ave: Set both corners using /minemories select first and second.
minemories.ui.identite_du_monde_distant_: Remote world identity for the timelapse.
minemories.ui.reglages_enregistres_recon: Settings saved. Reconnect your account to this API.
minemories.ui.fichier_local_enregistre_a: Local file saved. Nothing was sent.
minemories.ui.connecte_ton_compte_avant_: Connect your account before sending a memory.
minemories.ui.captures_afk_activees_meme: AFK captures enabled, even while paused.
minemories.ui.compte_connecte_tu_peux_ca: Account connected. You can capture and send. Technical diagnostics are on to help fix bugs (no personal data). You can turn them off in the Minemories settings.
minemories.ui.compte_deconnecte_tes_souv: Account disconnected. Your online memories are preserved.
minemories.ui.souvenirs_afk_automatiques: Automatic AFK memories, even while paused.
minemories.ui.afk_local_actif_connecte_t: Local AFK active. Connect your gallery to upload.
minemories.ui.entre_le_code_genere_dans_: Enter the code generated in your web gallery.
minemories.ui.joue_au_moins_une_minute_d: Play in an area for at least one minute.
minemories.ui.rejoins_une_zone_puis_choi: Return to an area and choose your export.
minemories.ui.aucun_identifiant_partage_: No identifier is shared with a Minecraft server.
minemories.ui.connecte_toi_a_un_serveur_: Connect to a server. Singleplayer worlds are identified automatically.
minemories.ui.connexion_modifiee_rouvre_: Connection changed. Reopen this screen from the relevant world.
minemories.ui.enregistre_une_serie_disti: Saved: a separate series for each connection.
minemories.ui.identifiant_conserve_pour_: Identifier saved for this world. Change it if its map is replaced.
minemories.ui.sans_identifiant_chaque_co: Without an identifier, each connection stays separate. To keep the same series after reconnecting, keep this world's identifier. Change it if the server map is replaced.
minemories.chat.pair_reminder: You are not connected to Minemories yet: your memories stay on this computer. Click here to connect.
minemories.chat.pair_diagnostics_notice: Technical diagnostics are on to help fix bugs (no personal data). You can turn them off in the Minemories settings.
minemories.hub.title: Minemories
minemories.hub.connected_hint: Your memories go to your gallery on their own.
minemories.hub.not_connected_hint: Type the code from your account to send your memories to your gallery.
minemories.hub.code_help_tooltip: Opens the Minemories website. Your code is in your gallery.
minemories.hub.take_tooltip: Saves what is around you right now.
minemories.hub.auto_tooltip: Takes a memory by itself when you stop playing for a while.
minemories.hub.memories_tooltip: See the memories saved on this computer.
minemories.hub.need_world: Join a world to take a memory.
minemories.hub.take_local_hint: Memories stay on this computer until you connect.
minemories.advanced.title: Advanced settings
